bug_semantics: When BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is unset or empty, TaxHacker substitutes a public constant as the better-auth JWT HMAC secret. At HEAD that constant is the Zod default 'please-set-your-key-here' on envSchema.parse in lib/config.ts (lines 14-17), assigned to config.auth.secret (line 65) and passed into betterAuth({ secret, session.strategy: 'jwt' }) in lib/auth.ts. Empty env values are stripped before parse, so docker-compose BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-} also lands on the default. An attacker who knows the default can mint HS256 taxhacker session JWTs and, in SELF_HOSTED_MODE=false (cloud/SaaS), pass proxy.ts cookie presence checks and auth.api.getSession verification, impersonating any user. In SELF_HOSTED_MODE=true the app auto-logs in via getSelfHostedUser and does not verify JWTs, but the same secret still keys better-auth and, via a sibling fallback in lib/encryption.ts, email-credential encryption. CVE-2026-78062 remains PUBLISHED; GHSA-c2p7-hcxm-xqhj is not withdrawn.
flaw_origin: The hardcoded JWT-secret fallback was first written in d8711b714285b545b4010faa6e7878eb7d16ff8b ('fix: pre-production fixes, add docker-compose.production.yml', 2025-04-03) as lib/config.ts `secret: process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET || "please-set-secret"` plus lib/auth.ts `secret: config.auth.secret`. Immediate parent 144e67dfa509a488766a1db4a414080d6fd05e0f had config.auth without a secret and betterAuth() without a secret option. Later bd6cd2c25c0420cf9f9cd679a98563bef735f5c1 only refactored the same fallback into envSchema.parse `.default("please-set-your-key-here")`; 69fc82f7d0ef3b6816f8d3ebb97f3fa5b20be0d9 made empty strings take that default instead of failing min(16); ec3b3c11916dccaad708bbbd94f4ec854a37cc58 documented an unimplemented ./data/.better_auth_secret generator. None of those later commits is the first write.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-78062/GHSA-c2p7-hcxm-xqhj describe hard-coded credentials in lib/config.ts envSchema.parse for BETTER_AUTH_SECRET. CVE.org is PUBLISHED (VulDB CNA; CISA-ADP enrichment 2026-08-27), not rejected, and GitHub withdrawn_at is not authoritative. The live sink at HEAD is the Zod .default('please-set-your-key-here') used as better-auth's JWT secret when the env var is missing or empty. That is a real CWE-798 for SELF_HOSTED_MODE=false deployments: a known HS256 key forges session JWTs. Default Docker self-hosted mode auto-authenticates without JWT, so the issue's cookie POC is not the self-hosted auth path, but the hardcoded secret still exists and is in every 0.8.x tag; the advisory is not a false positive. BIC search used -S/-L/blame then parent-tree verification, not AI-marker-first. The smallest first-write of the mechanism is d8711b714285b545b4010faa6e7878eb7d16ff8b, which added both the || 'please-set-secret' fallback and the betterAuth({ secret: config.auth.secret }) wiring. Parent 144e67dfa509a488766a1db4a414080d6fd05e0f was read directly: no config.auth.secret, no betterAuth secret, no please-set-secret. bd6cd2c is a next-day layout/config refactor that only changed the default string and introduced envSchema.parse; protocol forbids treating that refactor as BIC. potential_fix.approach: Remove the Zod .default("please-set-your-key-here") so BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is required, reject empty and known-placeholder values at startup, delete lib/encryption.ts's "insecure-self-hosted-secret" fallback, and either fail closed or implement the documented generate-and-persist path to ./data/.better_auth_secret so Docker compose empty ${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-} never signs JWTs with a source-visible key.
potential_fix.rationale: A required or uniquely generated secret eliminates the public HS256 key that lets an attacker forge better-auth session JWTs and also stops email-credential encryption from using a second hardcoded fallback.
